<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<CustomField xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>Connection_Type__c</fullName>
    <description>Named Credential: Salesforce logs in (OAuth, JWT, API key, Basic, AWS, certificate). Apex Auth: your Auth Class adds the login header at send time, for a custom token login a Named Credential cannot do. Blank means Named Credential.</description>
    <inlineHelpText>Named Credential: Salesforce logs in (OAuth, JWT, API key, Basic, AWS, certificate). Apex Auth: your Auth Class adds the login header at send time, for a custom token login a Named Credential cannot do. Blank means Named Credential.</inlineHelpText>
    <label>Connection Type</label>
    <required>false</required>
    <trackTrending>false</trackTrending>
    <type>Picklist</type>
    <valueSet>
        <restricted>true</restricted>
        <valueSetDefinition>
            <sorted>false</sorted>
            <value>
                <fullName>Named Credential</fullName>
                <default>true</default>
                <label>Named Credential</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>Apex Auth</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>Apex Auth</label>
            </value>
        </valueSetDefinition>
    </valueSet>
</CustomField>
